method: The 42 audit rows whose in-table quote was the provenance tag 'phase77_ingest' were re-joined by normalized DOI to the ingest-time verification artifacts (Ga2O3-Net results/phase77_new_data_sweep/{deduped,verify_191_result,deepen_result}.json), which retain per-row verbatim source quotes. Each numeric field of the audited row was then searched in the recovered quotes (scientific-notation-aware, rel. 1%); SUPPORTED = every non-null field found, PARTIAL = some, NOT_FOUND = none, NO_QUOTES = DOI absent from the artifacts.
